items.t: Port Coquitlam real estate market stats

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Central Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 17 houses and 131 condos and townhomes listed in Central Port Coquitlam. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Central Port Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes had 8% (a buyers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Central Port Coquitlam from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 4 houses and 77 condos and townhomes sold in Central Port Coquitlam over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in July with 2 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 29 sold.

faq.q: How big is Central Port Coquitlam compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Central Port Coquitlam held 11.1% of the 153 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 58.5% of the 224 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Central Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 11.5% of the 148 homes listed in Central Port Coquitlam and condos and townhomes made up 88.5%; of the 11 that sold, houses were 0.0% and condos and townhomes 100.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Central Port Coquitlam than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 22 to 17 (−22.7%) and condos and townhomes fell from 134 to 131 (−2.2%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
